research_questions: What are the most significant technical breakthroughs in CRISPR precision and efficiency in the last 12-24 months?
What is the current status and recent results of major CRISPR-based clinical trials (e.g., for Sickle Cell Disease, Transthyretin Amyloidosis)?
How have delivery mechanisms evolved to target specific organs or tissues beyond the liver?
What are the latest advancements in 'search-and-replace' technologies like Prime Editing?
What new regulatory milestones or approvals have been reached globally?
intent_analysis.success_criteria: A comprehensive report detailing the technical evolution of CRISPR tools, recent clinical successes, and new delivery methods that represent the current state-of-the-art in 2024.
missing_information: Specific sub-field of interest (e.g., human therapeutics, agriculture, or basic research)
Desired technical depth (academic/professional vs. general overview)
assumptions: The user is looking for the most recent developments (2023-2024).
The focus is primarily on human health and therapeutic applications unless otherwise specified.
The user has a foundational understanding of what CRISPR is and wants to see progress beyond basic Cas9 mechanisms.
